source_quote.quote: Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma Patients Who Possess the Novel Genomic Biomarker DGM1

flag.reason: Official title says patients who possess DGM1, but eligibility only requires DGM1 status (positive or negative) to be available and the short title says with or without DGM1; role may be stratification/exploratory, and its mechanistic link to enzastaurin is not stated.

source_quote.quote: Histologically proven, newly diagnosed supratentorial glioblastoma (IDH mutant is excluded)
Availability of tumor tissue representative of glioblastoma from surgery, and MGMT promoter methylation status is determined prior to study randomization

coder_notes: Enzastaurin arm is registered ACTIVE_COMPARATOR but is the investigational arm; placebo arm is the comparator. Placebo and radiotherapy not listed as agents. DGM1 coding is contradictory in the record (official title: patients who possess DGM1; short title: with or without DGM1; eligibility: status available, positive or negative), so enrichment plus candidate_matched true is a best guess and flagged. MGMT status is determined before randomisation, possibly as a stratification factor, but the record does not say so; coded exploratory_correlative. Eligibility cites WHO 2016 and excludes IDH mutant, so cns5 chosen per the both-criteria rule.
